_comment: Who is emailed the moment a fellow ticks 'I'd like someone to check in with me'.
If `recipients` is empty, the checkbox is OMITTED from every provisioned Part B
form and provisioning logs why. That is deliberate: a system that invites people
to ask for help and routes it nowhere is worse than one that never asks.
CU confirmed on 2026-08-10 that no dedicated Fellow-support responder role exists
yet. The Director of Programs does exist, so that is the named human here until
CU names someone else. Change `recipients` to change who is woken up.
